text: Penny gets a fifty dollar gift card for her birthday.
In a Bankrate survey, almost half of American adults had at least one unused gift card.
On average, a hundred and eighty-seven dollars each.
That's about twenty-three billion dollars, sitting in drawers.
The store already has the money.
And every card nobody spends is a sale with nothing to deliver.
Follow Money Mechanics for how the money really moves.
